channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Murder in Belfast: Sisters Seeking Justice
channel.desc: The killing of Robert McCartney erupted from nowhere: a Sunday night at a city pub ended in a gang attack and murder. As evidence vanishes, Robert's family aren't getting any answers. There is a race to find out what happened from the survivor of the stabbing - but the police aren't the only organisation trying to talk to witnesses.
